tips.header_subtitle: Everything you need to type faster and more comfortably with Ravaan.
tips.hk_convert_desc: Instantly converts the last word or selected text between Persian and English (e.g. 'sghl' ↔ 'سلام').
tips.hk_zwnj_desc: Inserts a standard zero-width non-joiner (نیم‌فاصله) in any application (e.g. 'می‌روم', 'کتاب‌ها').
tips.hk_undo_desc: Reverts the last auto-correction or layout conversion back to exactly what you typed.
tips.hk_clip_desc: Opens recent clipboard clips right at your caret. Press 1–5 or use arrows to paste instantly.
tips.hk_stats_desc: Shows word count, character count, and estimated reading time for selected text.
tips.hk_pause_desc: Temporarily pauses Ravaan assistance (for 10 minutes) or resumes it immediately.
tips.hk_clean_desc: Standardizes Persian characters (ي/ك to ی/ک), removes extra spaces, and fixes half-spaces on clipboard.
tips.feat_zwnj_desc: Automatically places half-spaces for Persian prefixes (می/نمی) and suffixes (ها/تر/ترین/هایم).
tips.feat_calc_desc: Type any math expression ending with '=' (e.g. '2500*4=' or '1200*1.09=') to replace with the answer.
tips.feat_autofix_desc: Detects when you type Persian words with English layout active (e.g. 'sghl ') and fixes them automatically.
tips.feat_snip_desc: Type customizable triggers like ';email' or ';addr' to expand into full text templates anywhere.
tips.feat_translit_desc: Press Ctrl+Alt+T to type Persian words using English letters phonetically ('salam' → 'سلام').
tips.trust_privacy_desc: Ravaan operates 100% offline on your PC. No keystrokes or typed words are ever recorded or sent anywhere.
tips.trust_pwd_desc: All popups and keystroke handling automatically suspend whenever a password field is active.
tips.trust_tray_desc: Right-click the Ravaan tray icon near the Windows clock to pause, toggle features, or open Settings.
